title: SigBootworks bootworks
description: Signature Bootworks is a Signature original: a Linux service manager where daemons are declared in SigUnit files (services, timers, sockets), supervised with restart policies and sandboxing, and messaged over the SigBus — the Signature take on OS service organization. Its unit schema, bus protocol, and tooling are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('sigunit enable inference.service  # daemon at boot')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
sigunit enable inference.service  # daemon at boot
edition: Signature original
